in_greek.name: Κορία
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the Hebrew 'kori' meaning 'anointed one'. In Greek mythology, 'Koria' is the name of a nymph and a city in the Peloponnese. However, in the context of Christianity, it is used as a feminine variant of the name 'Cor' meaning 'anointed'.

in_latin.name: Coria
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the Greek 'Koria' and the Hebrew 'kori'. In Latin literature, 'Coria' is the name of a town in Umbria. However, in the context of Christianity, it is used as a feminine variant of the name 'Cor' meaning 'anointed'.
